resume.title: Senior Application Support Engineer – AI Products & Agents
resume.summary: Production support engineer with nearly 3 years of incident response and RCA experience for 24/7 enterprise systems. Proven in Python automation, REST API validation, and runbook creation. Experienced in AWS cloud support, ServiceNow/ITSM, UAT/release validation, and cross-functional collaboration. Regulated-data exposure through governance/SEC-related data operations complements a strong operational skill set. Flexible work patterns and multi-role experience across FactSet, IGT, and Concentrix.

experience.title: Product Support Engineer / Research Analyst
bullets: Provided L2 production support for enterprise Workforce Management applications on Oracle databases and Linux servers, maintaining high availability and ~98.6% SLA.

Triage and resolve 8–10 production incidents daily, including application failures, batch processing issues, data inconsistencies, and performance degradation; escalated to development teams as needed.

Built Python automation for production health checks, log parsing, ServiceNow reporting, Control-M job validation, and release verification; reduced routine validation time from ~95 minutes to ~18 minutes per cycle.

Validated REST API integrations using Postman and Python scripts across 12–15 production releases; conducted deployment validation, smoke testing, SQL verification, and post-release monitoring; troubleshot Control-M batch job failures to improve reliability.

Authored runbooks, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides adopted by the team; onboarded a new engineer over ~4 months, covering troubleshooting workflow, SQL checks, Linux fundamentals, and incident handling.
Partnered with development, DBA, QA, and DevOps teams on root cause analysis and long-term preventive fixes.

experience.title: Technical Operations Analyst / Associate (Contract)
bullets: Primary technical point of contact for reservation-platform issues affecting global hotel operations.
Automated operational reporting and data validation using Python, SQL, and Power Query; built Power BI dashboards tracking reservation accuracy and SLA compliance.
Supported REST API testing between reservation and payment systems and participated in UAT for production releases; documented workflows and SOPs to reduce manual effort.
Used Salesforce as a professional operational/work-management tool to view and monitor work items and update notes.

experience.title: Technical Support Representative
bullets: Diagnosed and resolved complex connectivity issues (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN, modem provisioning) for broadband, voice, and networking services.
Authored troubleshooting guides; built a personal Linux home-lab and Python log-analysis scripts to enhance enterprise support skills.
